error.bad_json: Beeminder sent a response that could not be read: {error}
error.no_token: Set your Beeminder personal auth token in the plugin settings.
error.not_started: The request could not be started.
error.unauthorized: Beeminder rejected the auth token. Check it in the plugin settings.

auth_token.description: While logged in, copy the token from https://www.beeminder.com/api/v1/auth_token.json. It is stored in plain text in your Noctalia config.
auth_token.label: Personal Auth Token

bar_text.description: What to show next to the bee. Click the bee to see every goal.
bar_text.label: Bar Text

option.next_goal_requirement: Next Goal Requirement — workout +1 within 1 day

ignored_goals.description: Goal slugs left out of the bar text and the bee's color. They still appear in the goals panel.
ignored_goals.label: Ignored Goals

quiet_until_due.description: Hide the bar text until at least one goal is due today. The bee stays visible either way.
quiet_until_due.label: Quiet Until Due

refresh_minutes.description: How often to fetch your goals from Beeminder. Countdowns keep ticking between refreshes.
refresh_minutes.label: Refresh Interval (minutes)

show_bee.description: Show the bee icon. Turn this off when several instances sit side by side. The bee still appears on errors, or when there is no text to show.
show_bee.label: Show Bee
